input.headline: Trump authorizes 90-day pause on reciprocal tariffs

reasoning: The White House Rapid Response account (@RapidResponse47) quoted Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stating "We've given 90 days... the United States will negotiate in good faith," which confirms the administration authorized a 90-day pause on tariffs. This is an official primary source directly addressing the claim.
